name: Lyo.Geolocation
tagline: Provider-agnostic geospatial operations and persistence contracts.
description:
Provider-agnostic geospatial operations and persistence contracts.

**Archetype A (Lyo domain).** Vendor Maps clients (e.g. [`Lyo.Google.Geolocation.Client`](../../../Integration/Google/Lyo.Google.Geolocation.Client/README.md)) are Archetype C under `Integration/{Vendor}/`. See [package layout](../../../docs/package-layout.md).

examples.title: Consumer composition (example)

sections.title: Assemblies
sections.trail: This package does **not** reference HTTP clients or vendor SDKs. Wire providers and import mappers in the **host** (API, worker, tool).

sections.title: `IGeolocationService`
sections.text: Contract for geocoding, routing, time zone, and distance operations (implementations live in separate integration packages).

sections.title: `IGeolocationStore`
items: **`geolocation.address_source`** — import provenance: **`source_entity_*`** + **`imported_at`** (owner `address_id` on parent); external type strings come from the importing app (e.g. `GoogleMapsPlace`)

sections.title: Consumer composition (example)
sections.text: A worker or API registers **store + provider(s)** and owns mapping from vendor DTOs to `Address` + `Sources`: Vendor-specific `EntityRef` type names (e.g. `GoogleMapsPlace`) are defined in the integration package that performs the mapping, not in this assembly.

sections.title: See also
sections.text: [`Lyo.People.Models`](../People/Lyo.People.Models/README.md) — internal people rows with their own `*_source` tables; link across stores via `EntityRef` at import time.
